top_fixes.rule: Whenever at least one promise was recorded and no transfer followed, close `promise` / PRM regardless of notes on other products.
top_fixes.why: When a promise is recorded, the finalize code still defaults to close_outcome='no_promise' / close_code='RF'. So if the customer hangs up or adds a note on another product before wrapup reaches fin_promise, close_call sends no_promise/RF instead of promise/PRM.
top_fixes.fix: 1) In tool create_promise post_process_code, when the result is ok (data.ok true/'True'), set vars['promise_recorded']='true', vars['close_outcome']='promise' and vars['close_code']='PRM'. 2) In finalize code, replace the default with: if vars.get('promise_recorded') in ('true','True') and not vars.get('transferred'): close_outcome='promise', close_code='PRM', else the current no_promise/RF. 3) In wrapup, put a transition before the others: promise_recorded equals 'true' and the customer ends or other products only get notes -> fin_promise. 4) Have every xfer_* node set vars['transferred']='true' so that a transfer after a promise still closes as transferred.

top_fixes.rule: Plan/lower instalments/more time requests: describe nothing, `transfer_to_agent` queue `restructuring`, close transferred TRS.
top_fixes.why: A customer in hardship who asks for a payment plan, lower instalments or more time is told 'you cannot offer that' and is not transferred, so close_call never gets transferred/TRS and the transfer_to_agent call with queue restructuring is missing.
top_fixes.fix: In the hardship and hardship_notes nodes: add the value new_plan to the topic enum in extraction_schema ('wants a plan / lower instalments / more time'). Add the transition 'topic equals "new_plan" -> xfer_restructuring', evaluated before the other routes. In hardship.task_message, replace 'if they ask for one, say you cannot offer that' with 'If they ask for a payment plan, lower instalments or more time, do not describe or promise any plan terms; tell them you will pass them to a colleague who handles this, and transfer.' Make sure xfer_restructuring calls transfer_to_agent with queue='restructuring' baked in, and that its fin node sets outcome='transferred' and reason='TRS'.
